packageRules.description: Disable major updates for bincode until msvc-kit supports bincode v3. See: https://github.com/loonghao/vx/pull/378

Hold the opentelemetry monorepo below 0.33.0 until tracing-opentelemetry ships a release built against opentelemetry 0.33. tracing-opentelemetry 0.33.0 is the newest release and requires opentelemetry ^0.32.0, so bumping the monorepo to 0.33.0 splits the dependency graph and breaks the vx-metrics build. See: https://github.com/loonghao/vx/pull/1127
